abilities.name: Chop
abilities.note: chops a tree (needs an axe)

abilities.name: CloseDoor
abilities.note: closes a door

abilities.name: Collect
abilities.note: collects clay or reeds by hand

abilities.name: Dig
abilities.note: digs a plot of grass

abilities.name: DrawWater
abilities.note: fills the bag with water from a well

abilities.name: DumpWheelbarrow
abilities.note: tips a crop out of the wheelbarrow onto the compost

abilities.name: Gather
abilities.note: picks berries by hand

abilities.name: Milk
abilities.note: milks the cow

abilities.name: Mine
abilities.note: mines a rock (needs a pickaxe)

abilities.name: OpenDoor
abilities.note: opens a door

abilities.name: PickFruit
abilities.note: picks a fruit (three animations in turn)

abilities.name: PlantTree
abilities.note: plants a sapling in the tree spot

abilities.name: Pull
abilities.note: pulls a grown plant out of its plot

abilities.name: PullFiber
abilities.note: pulls fibre from a tuft of grass

abilities.name: Sow
abilities.note: sows seeds in a dug plot

abilities.name: Stoke
abilities.note: puts a piece of wood or a branch in a campfire (needs one in the bag)

abilities.name: Water
abilities.note: waters a sown plot or a sapling

commands.help: ability list [entity] | status [entity] | grant <ability> [entity] | activate <ability> [target] [actor] | cancel [ability] [actor] | apply <effect> [entity] | sync | store: gameplay abilities (Gardener = the player, Farmhand = an NPC; names with spaces in quotes)
commands.name: ability

commands.help: actor spawn <name> [model.fbx|fox|cesium] [x z] [player|ai] | list | control <name> | tasks <name> <task list>|stop | remove <name> | sync: the characters of the world (the player is one of them; NPCs use the same controller, animation and abilities). player_* commands act on the controlled one
commands.name: actor

commands.help: add <cube|sphere|plane|light|file.glb|file.gltf> [x y z]: adds an object (models are relative to the assets folder)
commands.name: add

commands.help: ai debug [on|off] | status [name] | memory <name> | scream <name>: the brain of the tribe members: needs, what they decide and why, what they know; `debug` draws their view cones, the obstacles and their memory in the viewport
commands.name: ai

commands.help: anim_stats [clip|all]: root motion, loop quality and foot plants measured from the clips of the loaded model
commands.name: anim_stats

commands.help: anims <file.fbx|folder>: adds the animation clips of an FBX file (or every FBX in a folder) to the loaded model, matching bones by name
commands.name: anims

commands.help: audio_record <file.wav>: records what the engine mixes (headless runs mix in step with the simulation) until audio_stop
commands.name: audio_record

commands.help: audio_stop: writes the recorded audio
commands.name: audio_stop

commands.help: autosave [on|off] [seconds]: saves to the 'autosave' slot on a timer (default every 300 s); without arguments, the state
commands.name: autosave

commands.help: camera <yaw> <pitch> <distance> [x y z]: places the orbit camera (angles in degrees). camera game follow [actor] | overview [x z [distance]] | observe [actor...|all] | off: the game cameras (H19)
commands.name: camera

commands.help: character_check [character.fbx]: checks a character (the player's when no file is given): skeleton convention, bones, size and facing, clip roles, sets, montages and what is wrong
commands.name: character_check

commands.help: character_export <file.json> [character.fbx]: writes the character check as JSON (the player's when no character is given)
commands.name: character_export

commands.help: clear: empties the console
commands.name: clear

commands.help: clips: lists the animation clips of the loaded model
commands.name: clips

commands.help: content status | export <file.json> | load <file.json>: the items, recipes, resource nodes and tribe roles, the interactives and the animal species as data (the pack era1, assets/data/era1.json and world.json, is read at start: see `pack`); load adds to or replaces by id, all sections or none
commands.name: content

commands.help: docs export <file.json>: writes what the rules say about themselves (abilities, effects, attributes and tags by kind of entity, needs, senses, roles, seasons, ecology settings) as one JSON; tools/make_wiki.py builds the wiki from it
commands.name: docs

commands.help: echo <text>: prints text (for scripts)
commands.name: echo

commands.help: ecology spawn [n] [x z] [species] | status | season [spring|summer|autumn|winter]: animals of the species of assets/data/world.json (rabbits eat berry bushes and fibre tufts, foxes hunt rabbits) wander, eat, breed when fed (not in winter) and starve; season shows or sets the season (it follows the simulation clock)
commands.name: ecology

commands.help: economy status | plan | give <item> [n] | stockpile <name> [x z] [kind] | demand <source> <item> <n>: the clan's economy (H18): what it makes from what (production chains), what spoils, its stores and stockpiles, what it hauls and how much food it brings in; give puts things in the main store
commands.name: economy

commands.help: entity create|delete|duplicate|rename|parent|select|add|remove|set|interact|info|list ...: edits the scene's entities
commands.name: entity

commands.help: field status | mark [x z]: the clan's fields (H18, E7): plots grass, tilled, sown, sprouting or ripe, what needs water and what the season allows; mark lays out a field (the clan does it by itself once it knows tillage and has seeds)
commands.name: field

commands.help: frame: looks at the middle of the world again
commands.name: frame

commands.help: garden build [x z] | status: builds the vegetable garden (plots, tree spot, fruit tree, cow, boxes, wheelbarrow, the Gardener and the Farmhand with their abilities) at a point (default: the middle of the view)
commands.name: garden

commands.help: generate <temperate|alpine|desert> [seed] [trees] [rocks]: builds a new world
commands.name: generate

commands.help: get <property>: prints a value
commands.name: get

commands.help: graph: lists the states, transitions and parameters of the animation graph and where it is now
commands.name: graph

commands.help: graph_declare <name> float|bool|trigger: declares a parameter of the graph
commands.name: graph_declare

commands.help: graph_default: replaces the graph with one state per locomotion set of the character
commands.name: graph_default

commands.help: graph_enable on|off: lets the graph drive the animation, or not
commands.name: graph_enable

commands.help: graph_load <file.json>: replaces the animation graph with the one in a file
commands.name: graph_load

commands.help: graph_param <name> <value>: sets a parameter the conditions read
commands.name: graph_param

commands.help: graph_save <file.json>: writes the animation graph
commands.name: graph_save

commands.help: graph_start <state>: the state the graph begins in
commands.name: graph_start

commands.help: graph_state <name> locomotion|montage <target> [x y]: adds a state, or changes it when the name exists
commands.name: graph_state

commands.help: graph_state_remove <name>: removes a state and the transitions that touch it
commands.name: graph_state_remove

commands.help: graph_transition <from|*> <to> [Speed>2 ...] [blend=0.3] [priority=1] [min=0.5] [finish]: adds a transition; every condition must hold
commands.name: graph_transition

commands.help: graph_transition_remove <index>: removes a transition (the numbers are listed by graph)
commands.name: graph_transition_remove

commands.help: graph_trigger <name>: fires a trigger parameter
commands.name: graph_trigger

commands.help: graph_validate: lists what would stop the graph from working (unknown states, sets, montages, parameters)
commands.name: graph_validate

commands.help: hdri <file.hdr|off>: uses an HDR environment for the sky and reflections
commands.name: hdri

commands.help: help [command]: lists the commands, or explains one
commands.name: help

commands.help: interact <entity> [point]: the player goes to an interaction point of an entity and uses it (underscores in names stand for spaces); no argument lists the points of the scene
commands.name: interact

commands.help: interactives build [x z] | status: puts a campfire (Stoke with wood), a well (DrawWater) and a gate (OpenDoor, CloseDoor) in the scene; their state is saved with the game
commands.name: interactives

commands.help: knowledge status [name|clan] | grant <name|clan> <tech> | techs: what each tribe member and the clan know of the technologies (H11), what they are learning and trying; grant teaches one at once
commands.name: knowledge

commands.help: list [prefix]: the properties you can get/set
commands.name: list

commands.help: load <name>: loads a saved game; a damaged or incompatible one is refused and nothing changes
commands.name: load

commands.help: load_model <model.glb|gltf>, or load <model.glb|gltf>: puts a glTF model in the scene (animated clips are listed in the Model panel)
commands.name: load_model

commands.help: manifest_info: the animation manifest (sets, montages, packs) and what the FBX player has clips for
commands.name: manifest_info

commands.help: manifest_load <file.json>: replaces the animation manifest (rebuilds the FBX player's sets, turns, jump and montages)
commands.name: manifest_load

commands.help: manifest_save <file.json>: writes the animation manifest in use
commands.name: manifest_save

commands.help: montage_info [montage]: describes a montage (clip, slot, blends, rate, notifies, sections); no name lists them
commands.name: montage_info

commands.help: montage_load <file.json>: adds (or replaces, by name) the montages of a file that the character has clips for
commands.name: montage_load

commands.help: montage_notify <montage> add <time 0..1> <name> | remove <name> | move <name> <time 0..1>: edits a montage's notifies (time as a fraction of its clip)
commands.name: montage_notify

commands.help: montage_save <file.json>: writes every montage of the player (notifies and sections included)
commands.name: montage_save

commands.help: montage_section <montage> add <time 0..1> <name> | remove <name>: edits a montage's sections
commands.name: montage_section

commands.help: montage_seek <montage> <seconds>|off: previews a montage paused at that moment of its clip; off releases it
commands.name: montage_seek

commands.help: montage_set <montage> blendin|blendout|rate|loop|striptravel|slot <value>: edits a montage's settings
commands.name: montage_set

commands.help: nav status | debug on|off | rebuild | sync | path <x1 z1 x2 z2> [load 0-1]: navigation over the terrain: the grid the characters plan their paths on (trunks, rocks, deep water and cliffs are walls; wading and slopes cost), the paths they follow and what the planning has cost
commands.name: nav

commands.help: new_scene: an empty scene (camera and sun only, no generated world); same as `scene new`
commands.name: new_scene

commands.help: pack list | load <id|manifest.json> [strict] | check: the eras as data packs (assets/data/<id>.pack.json: its content files, the packs it depends on, what is given, the stations, the known gaps). load loads the missing dependencies first, all or nothing, and checks that every item and recipe can be had (strict: a problem refuses the load); era1 is loaded at start
commands.name: pack

commands.help: panel <name> [on|off]: shows or hides a panel (Animation, Model, Stats, ...); panel Animation tab <Character|Animator|Montages|Sockets|IK> picks its tab
commands.name: panel

commands.help: play <clip name|index> [fade seconds]: plays a clip of the loaded model
commands.name: play

commands.help: player [fox|cesium|<character.fbx>|off] [keys]: walk the world in third person (WASD, Shift runs, drag the mouse to look). An FBX character loads its folder's animations and walks with the locomotion blend. keys = a script like "W:2,RW:3,:1" for headless runs
commands.name: player

commands.help: player_attach [box|bag|tool|off]: the FBX player carries a prop (box in both hands with IK, a bag on the back, a tool in the hand); off lets go; no argument lists what is carried
commands.name: player_attach

commands.help: player_blast <x> <z> [radius] [speed]: an explosion on the ground there; within its radius the player is thrown as a ragdoll
commands.name: player_blast

commands.help: player_feet on|off: the FBX player's feet follow the terrain with IK (on by default)
commands.name: player_feet

commands.help: player_getup: the ragdoll stands up where it lies (facing the way its head points) and blends back to the animation
commands.name: player_getup

commands.help: player_goto <x> <z> [run]: an AI leads the player character to that point (same controller, animation and footsteps as the keyboard)
commands.name: player_goto

commands.help: player_hit <x> <y> <z>: an impulse (N s) on the ragdoll's pelvis (a blow)
commands.name: player_hit

commands.help: player_look <x> <y> <z> | camera | off: the FBX player turns its head toward a world point, the camera, or forward again
commands.name: player_look

commands.help: player_montage [name [section]|stop]: plays a one-shot action (pick_fruit, water, milk_cow...) over the FBX player; no name lists them
commands.name: player_montage

commands.help: player_overlay [name] [fade seconds]: switches the locomotion set of the FBX player (box, holding, wheelbarrow, free); no name lists them
commands.name: player_overlay

commands.help: player_ragdoll [vx vy vz]: the FBX player collapses into a ragdoll (bodies and joints in a physics world made of the same ground, water, trees and rocks), keeping its speed plus the given one; it gets up by itself after a pause
commands.name: player_ragdoll

commands.help: player_tasks <task list>|stop: the player does a list of tasks like an NPC (goto x z [run] | interact <entity> [point] | wait s | attach prop | detach [prop] | ability <name> [entity], separated by '|' or new lines)
commands.name: player_tasks

commands.help: quality <minimum|low|medium|high|ultra>: post-processing preset (minimum also renders at 60% resolution without MSAA and draws less far, for slow GPUs)
commands.name: quality

commands.help: quickload: loads the 'quicksave' slot (F9)
commands.name: quickload

commands.help: quicksave: saves to the 'quicksave' slot (F5)
commands.name: quicksave

commands.help: quit: closes the editor
commands.name: quit

commands.help: redo: re-applies an undone scene edit
commands.name: redo

commands.help: region list | info <id|name> | explore: the regions of the generated world (H12): area, biome, water, wild resources and danger; what the clan knows of each, its expedition and its moves
commands.name: region

commands.help: replay record | replay stop [file] | replay play <file>: records the orders of a session and plays them again from the same start to check the end state
commands.name: replay

commands.help: resources build [x z [workers]] | world [density] | status: puts trees, rocks, berry bushes and fibre tufts in the scene to gather from (build: a patch around a point; world: spread over the generated map by biome) (abilities Chop, Mine, Gather; the yield goes to the actor's bag, see actor bag)
commands.name: resources

commands.help: retarget <animations.fbx|folder>: applies the animations of another skeleton (any naming, proportions or rest pose) to the FBX player; the clips are added to it and its animator rebuilt
commands.name: retarget

commands.help: run <script.txt>: runs the commands in a file
commands.name: run

commands.help: save <name>: saves the game (world seed, edits, garden, clock, weather) in saves/<name>.gbsave
commands.name: save

commands.help: saves: lists the saved games with their date and version
commands.name: saves

commands.help: scene new|save <file>|load <file>: scene files (JSON)
commands.name: scene

commands.help: screenshot <file.png>: saves the viewport (the 3D view without the interface)
commands.name: screenshot

commands.help: select <name|id|none>: selects an entity
commands.name: select

commands.help: set <property> <value...>: changes a value (numbers, true/false, enum names, 'r g b' or #rrggbb)
commands.name: set

commands.help: shot_ui <file.png>: saves the whole window, panels included, at the end of this frame
commands.name: shot_ui

commands.help: stats: frame time, objects drawn/culled and world counts
commands.name: stats

commands.help: test <name> [sandbox]: builds a Sandbox test scene in the viewport (sandbox = run the original in its own window)
commands.name: test

commands.help: tests: lists the Sandbox test scenes you can run with `test <name>`
commands.name: tests

commands.help: time <hours>: sets the hour of the day (0-24) and turns time of day on
commands.name: time

commands.help: timescale <1-20>: runs the simulation (gameplay, actors, tribe) that many times per frame; 1 is real time
commands.name: timescale

commands.help: tribe build [model.fbx|fox] [x z] [workers] | status | jobs | log [n] | remove <name> | clear: the first tribe: workers (named from the data, their trades shared out by the clan's needs) gather, carry to a store, make tools and light a campfire by themselves; they get better at what they practise and take jobs from the clan's board
commands.name: tribe

commands.help: undo: reverts the last scene edit
commands.name: undo

commands.help: wait <frames>: in a script, pauses for that many frames
commands.name: wait

commands.help: weather <clear|lightrain|rain|storm|snow|blizzard|dust|sandstorm|tornado> [snap]
commands.name: weather

abilities.name: Stoke

abilities.name: OpenDoor
abilities.note: opens a door

abilities.name: CloseDoor
abilities.note: closes a door

abilities.name: DrawWater
abilities.note: fills the bag with water from a well
